hero.purpose: The home page's one hero headline.

h1.purpose: The page-level heading on every restrained-tier page (ask, conversations, files, workspaces, login, register, about, beta, new workspace).

h2.purpose: Feature-row headings on the home page (What is RAG?, Workspaces).

h2-operate.purpose: Sub-headings on restrained-tier pages (Past conversations, Files) — one step below H1 Operate.

body-lg.purpose: The hero's intro line only — one deliberate size step up.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, source-chip labels, the beta mark, form labels.

mono.purpose: Code blocks only — never generic 'technical' decoration.

shadows.name: light-directional
shadows.usage: Light mode depth on faceted surfaces (home page only).

shadows.name: dark-crease-highlight
shadows.usage: Dark mode depth substitute — a highlight border, never a shadow.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.usage: The one authored motion moment — home page hero only, on load.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.usage: Buttons and source chips on hover/focus.

components.name: Button (Primary)
components.description: Coral fill, Ink text, fold-cut top-right corner. Used for the one primary action on a page — the home CTA and every form's submit button.
components.css: .origami-button-primary { display: inline-block; background: #FF6B6B; color: #1A1A1A; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem; border: none; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Button (Secondary / Ghost)
components.description: Transparent fill, fold-cut corner, for utility actions (Edit, Save, Delete, Refresh) that shouldn't compete with a page's one primary action.
components.css: .origami-button-secondary { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #1A1A1A; border: 1px solid #B0B0B0; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; } .origami-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #FF6B6B; color: #B34B4B; }

components.name: Source Chip (ask page)
components.description: A real anchor link to a cited source, fold-cut corner, the accent's one text use in light mode.
components.css: .ds-source-chip { display: inline-block; color: #B34B4B; border: 1px solid #B34B4B; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-source-chip:hover, .ds-source-chip:focus-visible { background: #B34B4B; color: #FAFAFA; }

components.name: Beta Mark
components.description: The one status marker sitewide: a fold-cut rectangle reusing the one accent.
components.css: .beta-badge { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #FF6B6B; border: 2px solid #FF6B6B; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Label above input, 1px border, 2px coral focus ring with offset, no floating labels — used on Log In, Register, New Workspace, and file rename/upload forms.
components.css: label { display: block; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } input[type="email"] { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; border: 1px solid #B0B0B0; padding: 0.5rem; background: #FAFAFA; color: #1A1A1A; } input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF6B6B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Page Actions
components.description: A row directly below a restrained page's .page-intro sentence, echoing the home hero's h1 → intro → CTA rhythm. Holds the page's primary next step as one or two existing Button components — one Primary if it's the sole action, or Primary + Secondary when a forward action (e.g. "New question") pairs with an alternate one (e.g. "See past conversations").
components.html:
Browse your workspaces, or create a new one.

Create a new workspace
components.css: .page-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; }

narrative.overview:
Dir Query's visual identity is built from a single physical idea: a flat sheet becomes dimensional through precise, deliberate folds. Every accented shape carries one clipped corner (the fold cut), and it appears only where it means something: buttons, source citations, the beta mark. Passive containers stay plain rectangles.

This world now governs the entire site at two intensities: full expression on the home page (hero, crease-line tessellation, zig-zag layout, one authored entrance animation) and restrained expression everywhere else (ask page, workspaces, login/register, about/beta, conversations, files) — same tokens and fold-cut device, but no tessellation, no hero, no motion.

This replaces "The Lab Notebook," which briefly governed the ask page alone, and also fully retires the prior bare/unstyled "Legacy" baseline that used to cover the rest of the site — there is no unmigrated page left, and no legacy-* token remains.
keyCharacteristics: One functional accent (Coral / Coral Ink) reserved for interactive elements; Sky, Sage, and Warm Crease are decorative-only, confined to the hero's crease-line texture.
The fold-cut corner is the system's one recurring shape device, reserved for buttons, source chips, and the beta mark — never on passive containers.
Depth is directional light on paper: an offset+blur shadow in light mode, a crease-highlight border (not a shadow) in dark mode.
Poppins carries all text sitewide, loaded via Google Fonts CDN; the existing mono stack is unchanged and unextended.
One authored motion moment: the home hero's staggered fade-up entrance. Nothing else animates on load.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral (or Coral Ink in light mode) is the only functional/interactive color sitewide. Sky, Sage, and Warm Crease are decorative-only.

rules.name: The Neutral Swap Rule
rules.body: Steel and Fold Shadow trade jobs between modes: Steel is text in light / border in dark, Fold Shadow is border in light / text in dark.

rules.name: The Crease, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Sky, Sage, and Warm Crease render only as thin diagonal hairlines in the crease-grid texture, never as solid filled shapes.

rules.name: The Crease Light Rule
rules.body: Light mode expresses depth as an offset+blur shadow; dark mode as a highlight border — never both, and never a shadow substituting for the fold-cut shape.

rules.name: The Cut Corner Rule
rules.body: The fold cut marks something actionable or referenced — a button, a link-chip, a citation. It never decorates a passive container.

dos: Do keep Coral (or Coral Ink in light mode) as the only functional accent sitewide.
Do reserve the fold-cut corner for actionable/referenced elements only.
Do keep the crease-grid tessellation and hero entrance motion exclusive to the home page.
Do verify any new text/background pairing against real contrast math — Coral fails as light-mode text (2.7:1); Coral Ink exists to fix that.
donts: Don't add a second functional hue. Sky/Sage/Warm Crease are decorative-only.
Don't put a fold cut on a passive container.
Don't use a conventional box-shadow in dark mode.
Don't add a second webfont beyond Poppins without a deliberate follow-up decision.
Don't reintroduce a bare/unstyled baseline — every page now carries body.origami-world.
